name: Enalyzer
description_en:
Enalyzer is a product in the Surveys and feedback category. Its directory profile covers Skip Logic, Survey Templates, Support Audio / Images / Video, Site Intercept Survey, Question Library, Question Branching, Online Survey, Offline Response Collection.

Additional listed capabilities include Multiple Question Types, Mobile Survey, Kiosk Survey, Embeddable Survey, Email Distribution, Data Analysis Tools, 360 Degree Feedback. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business Freelancers. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $26.00. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: choose subsequent questions using earlier answers. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
